text: Pogačar arrives at his spiritual home short one climber—McNulty's withdrawal strips him of crucial support on back-to-back Alpe d'Huez stages—but a 4:32 cushion over Evenepoel should hold even if UAE Team Emirates has to ride defensively. Watch for Ayuso and Seixas to probe relentlessly on the Col du Noyer and Ornon; they're close enough that a single attack could fracture the group before the final climb sorts things out. Evenepoel has the engine to trouble Pogačar on the HC ramp, but he'll need a teammate to drive the pace early and force Pogačar to respond, a luxury Bora may lack if the break survives into the foothills.
